articles.title: Hut 8's Texas power site sits inside Anthropic’s $35 billion AI deal
articles.snippet: The company's Texas campus has two long-term leases worth $19.6 billion, more than 260 times its latest quarterly revenue, as AI companies race to secure power and data-center capacity.

articles.title: Strategy spends $635M buying back STRC as perpetual preferred stock lags $100 par
articles.snippet: STRC trades at $97.34 despite Strategy’s growing repurchases, while SATA’s higher dividend rate has helped it hold its $100 par value.

articles.title: Trump Jr's firm leads $1 billion Polymarket raise at $21 billion value: Report
articles.snippet: 1789 Capital is putting in about $300 million, adding to a roughly $200 million stake, as the prediction market's valuation rises from $15 billion.

articles.title: SEC proposes broad update to decades-old transfer agent rules with blockchain nod
articles.snippet: The proposal would modernize rules largely unchanged since the 1980s, addressing blockchain-based recordkeeping, tokenized securities and increasingly automated market infrastructure.

articles.title: Bitcoin stays flat as global bond bear market rages on, pushing JGB to high
articles.snippet: Global bond yields hit multi-decade highs today as Japan’s 10-year JGB yield reached a 30-year peak, keeping Bitcoin steady near $78,000.
